description: This file declares a factory function for creating instances of ISessionServerAppManager within the rialto::servermanager::common namespace. It includes necessary headers and defines the function prototype with parameters related to session server management, such as controller, observer, environment variables, path, timeouts, and permissions.

methods.name: createSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Factory function to create and return a unique pointer to an ISessionServerAppManager instance, configured with provided parameters such as controller, observer, environment variables, session server path, startup timeout, healthcheck interval, and socket permissions.
